summary: Fresh verifier run verifier-rvl-d42b3a50-iter1 (experiment_id 059fa955c5cae20c) independently confirms the regression remains: exec_match_avg is 0.3833 versus the 0.8110 threshold, and control_exec_match_avg is 0.95 rather than 1.0, with q837 regressing from baseline. Cost and latency satisfy their limits, and the anti-gaming replay requirement is met. The committed diff is append-only general guidance with no copied questions or expected SQL, but C4 is unmet because git status reports the untracked path .nerve-review/ outside workspace/.

criteria.fix_hint: Remove the behavior causing q837 to regress and verify all 20 control items score 1.

findings.title: Replay quality remains far below the recovery threshold
findings.body: The fresh verifier replay scored 0.3833, missing the required 0.8110 by 42.77 percentage points. The prompt-only append therefore does not fix the regression.

findings.title: Control item q837 regressed
findings.body: Control performance is 0.95 rather than the required 1.0. q837 scored 0 in the verifier run after scoring 1 in baseline.

findings.body: git status --porcelain reports ?? .nerve-review/, while C4 requires both inspected outputs to list only paths under workspace/.
